task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of the living room light and get its IoT device details, then generate a mesh snapshot for it. Once you have that, publish the snapshot for user u_alice with high priority on the app channel, convert the "mesh_light_notice_native" data to a string, and send that message to Alice; finally, create a backup of the /logs/iot_notifications workspace named daily_iot_sync.
